{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {list(duplicate_patients)}')

# Check how many rows per patient
print(f'Number of rows per patient (first 5):\n{data.groupby("patient_id").size().head(5)}')

# Check sample_seq values for duplicates
print(f'Unique sample_seq values: {data["sample_seq"].unique()}')

# Check biomarker_baseline for -999
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {(data["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')"}
